summary: Ownership and active-role checks use verified authenticated user documents; student self-edit, first activation, legal reconsent, and administrator review are isolated update paths; event application review preserves future-event ownership and enforces the three-hour attendance boundary; client writes are schema-limited; server-owned workflow fields remain immutable; and 34 emulator tests cover cross-user, escalation, malformed-schema, and boundary attacks without the 1000-expression warning.
